title: SchemaMigration
description: Represents a database schema migration or deploy request, used to apply DDL changes against a managed database in a controlled, reviewable way.

id.description: Unique identifier for the migration or deploy request.

database_instance_id.description: Identifier of the database instance the migration targets.

source_branch.description: Source branch the migration was developed on.

target_branch.description: Target branch the migration applies to.

ddl.description: DDL statement(s) that the migration applies.
ddl.example: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN shipping_address TEXT NULL;

strategy.description: Strategy used to apply the migration.

is_blocking.description: Whether the migration blocks reads or writes while running.

applied_by.description: User or service account that applied the migration.

rollback_ddl.description: Optional inverse DDL used to roll back the migration.
rollback_ddl.example: ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN shipping_address;

checks.description: Automated safety checks run against the migration before approval.
